title: Exponential stability of abstract boundary-coupled positive systems
summary: In this paper, we study the well-posedness and exponential stability of a class of abstract boundary-coupled positive systems. Within a general semigroup framework, we establish well-posedness in terms of existence, uniqueness, and regularity of solutions. More concretely, we derive some simple and readily verifiable tests on the boundary coupling operators for the verification of the well-posedness of the coupled system and, at the same time, provide spectral criteria that guarantee exponential stability of the solutions.
